characters.name: Mira
characters.description: young girl with dark hair, a green jacket, and red boots

source.name: Mira's Paper Boat
source.text:
Mira carried her blue paper boat to the garden pond at sunrise. The boat had one yellow star painted on its side. Her orange cat Nori waited on the dry path and did not enter the water. Mira wanted to see whether the boat would float, but she set it on a flat stone first.

A sharp reed had made a small hole in the boat while Mira carried it. Water would leak through that hole. Mira found a square of waxed paper in her pocket and pressed it over the hole. She did not put the boat in the pond yet. Nori stayed on the path.

Clouds gathered, and a strong wind began to blow. Mira lifted the patched boat from the stone and took it into the garden shed. Nori waited outside the shed door. Mira placed the boat on a wooden shelf, with its yellow star facing her, so the patch could dry before another test.

At sunset the wind was still strong. Mira left the boat on the shelf and closed the shed door. She and Nori walked home along the dry path. The boat had never touched the pond. Mira planned to return another day, but the story does not tell us whether the patched boat would float.
